name: load_event_sound_data

stack.evidence: func_001EA190 consumes a world index and resource ID, formats eventse/%s_%03d.dat with D_003D7C88[world_index], queues that file through cdvd_QueueFileLoad, and decrements Script stackTop by two

notes: D_003D7C88 is a six-byte-stride table of world abbreviations including al, lm, pc, pp, and tz. The load completion callback passes the file to the event-sound resource parser func_0011CC20. All 18 JP calls are followed by command 385 wait_for_event_sound_data_load.
